description: Withdraw USDC out of this account's verified Arc home Safe in one resumable owner-signed call. chain=arc is a same-chain Safe transfer with no Circle fee (Felix pays the Arc gas). chain=base|polygon|arbitrum|ethereum goes through Circle Gateway: the owner pays the Gateway fee ceiling and the destination-chain mint gas. The destination must be the owner's own address or a Felix-allowlisted address on that chain (add_withdrawal_address allowlists Polygon). Every SafeTx and burn intent is verified against this exact request before it is signed locally; a mismatch refuses without a signature. Not live-certified on this release.

amount_usd.description: USDC to deliver to the destination, at most six decimals.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable workflow key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

max_fee_usd.description: Owner-paid Circle Gateway fee ceiling for a cross-chain withdrawal. Defaults to 0.05; must be 0 for chain=arc.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only to resume this exact interrupted withdrawal after reading its operation.

submit_destination_mint.description: For a cross-chain withdrawal to the owner's own address, also broadcast the final mint with the owner key through your own FELIX_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL. Defaults to true; the mint gas is owner paid.

to.description: Exact destination: the owner address, or an address allowlisted for that chain.

withdrawal_confirmation.description: Email-confirmation proof for this exact withdrawal, returned by /v1/withdraw/confirmation/verify. Required by the engine for a new withdrawal preparation.

proof.description: Opaque verified proof; never a private key or email code.

name: arc_home_withdraw
